topics.description: Child care fraud is a growing concern, with a former Seattle-based federal agency head stating that it is 'common'. The issue is being investigated by various agencies, including the DOJ.
Ponzi schemes are being uncovered at an alarming rate, with the Woodhill Ponzi scheme being a recent example. These schemes can result in significant financial losses for investors.
topics.reason: Recent discoveries of large-scale Ponzi schemes
